data.summary: Malerbetrieb Muster invoices €1,130.50 (including 19% VAT) for painting work completed on 12 August 2026 in your flat at Lindenweg 12. Payment is due within 14 days of receiving the invoice.
data.explanation: This is an invoice from a painting company for walls and ceilings in 3 rooms plus material. Transfer the total of €1,130.50 to the bank account printed on the invoice within 14 days of receiving it. Use the invoice number as the payment reference. Check that the work matches what was agreed. If you are unsure about anything, ask the company before paying. Keep the invoice, as craftsman labour costs in your own home may be tax-deductible.
